verdict.rationale: The Weave trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads a complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec of 117 paths and runs requests in-page against production, with a ReDoc view as well. The hosted reference pages also add a per-endpoint "Try it" playground. The docs-listed spec path returns 404 and only the trace.wandb.ai spec works, which is a minor wrinkle. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the interactive consoles work, evidence of pre-filled example request payloads, a working spec link at the docs-listed path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API; a ReDoc view answers at /redoc.
The hosted endpoint reference pages on docs.coreweave.com additionally render a "Try it" API playground per endpoint

The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
